current.text: Adams is Houston's backup center behind Alperen Sengun.
In fantasy he is only a rebound streamer for certain matchups.
Lloyd expects him to sit back-to-backs, and definitely at the start of the season.
Houston has only 14 back-to-backs this season, so resting on back-to-backs costs him fewer games.
Houston is expected to use double-big lineups with Adams and Sengun at times. With Adams back, Jabari Smith Jr. plays more power forward than center.
Coach Ime Udoka focuses on defense and sometimes plays other bigs over Sengun, which limits Sengun's minutes.
Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes, which limits the minutes left for bench players like Adams.
With our March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21.

durable.text: He is arguably the greatest offensive rebounder in NBA history. Opponents often need two or three bodies to keep him off the glass.
He makes no threes and scores very few points. Both are clear weaknesses against the league pool.

note: Adams is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 397, ESPN rank 329), and he projects about 4 points and no threes per game. His use is as a waiver streamer for rebounds in good matchups. Last season he averaged 8.6 rebounds in 22.8 minutes. Early in the season, check whether Houston really plays him next to Sengun in double-big lineups and whether he sits back-to-backs.
